name: event-bus
description: Typed global event bus singleton supporting on, off, emit, once, and clear operations for decoupled component communication.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need a lightweight publish-subscribe mechanism to decouple modules without a full state management library. Useful for cross-component communication in UI apps, plugin systems, or service-to-service notifications.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: The event name to subscribe to, publish, or clear.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: The callback function to invoke when the event is emitted.
